entities.name: Query IspD/IspF
observations: 373 aa; estimated molecular mass 41.87 kDa and pI 6.67.
Strong full-length similarity to reviewed bifunctional IspD/IspF proteins; best hit A6Q2K0 has 64.1% identity, 100% query and target coverage, E-value 4.87e-176.
Likely catalyzes two methylerythritol phosphate pathway steps, but assignment is homology-supported rather than direct biochemical characterization of this sequence.

entities.name: MEP cytidylyltransferase reaction
observations: Corresponds to IspD activity in the non-mevalonate/isoprenoid pathway.

entities.name: ME-CPP synthase reaction
observations: Corresponds to IspF activity in the non-mevalonate/isoprenoid pathway.

entities.name: Divalent metal cation
observations: Reviewed IspD/IspF homolog annotations report dependence on a divalent metal cation; the specific ion is not established for this query sequence.
